description.value: Delight Street Eats is an Indian street food restaurant in Delta serving an extensive menu of chaat, biryani, thalis, and Asian fusion items from breakfast through late night. The kitchen accommodates vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, and nut-free diets with menu filters available on their online ordering platform. Dine-in, pickup, and delivery within 15 km are all supported.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms an active Indian street food restaurant at 8939 120 St (= Scott Road), Delta, with online ordering, pickup, and delivery. Menu filters on the website explicitly list Vegetarian, Vegan, and Gluten Free options; pickup is confirmed via the ordering system. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all required cycling criteria are null.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists street as 'Scott Road' but the business website consistently shows '120 St' (Scott Road is the colloquial name for 120th Street in Delta — likely the same physical road, but the mismatch should be confirmed and OSM corrected).
OSM record has no phone number; website shows 604-797-1100 — phone contact_confirmed set to null as there is nothing in OSM to corroborate.
Email on website (info@delightindianbistro.com) references a different brand name ('Delight Indian Bistro'), which may indicate a rebrand or shared ownership — worth noting for directory accuracy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The restaurant is clearly open and offers food options relevant to cyclists (vegetarian/vegan/GF, takeout), but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website or OSM tags. On-site verification is needed before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Catering is advertised on the website, which could be relevant if the directory tracks catering-capable venues. The business email domain (delightindianbistro.com) differs from the trading name and website domain (delightstreeteats.com).
